stage4_contract: raw-carrier reference totality for every accepted TEPL selector
stage5_deferred_contract: target numeric interpretation, rounding, saturation, exceptional values, and hardware conformance

selector_scope.excluded: reserved or non-TEPL direct tile selectors reject through the generated decoder before semantic handlers

policy.data_types: all 25 architectural TileDataType values are accepted as pto-v0 raw XLEN carriers for TEPL
policy.layouts: row-major and column-major generic layouts are accepted where operation shape rules permit them; implementation-defined layouts are configured state but rejected by generic TEPL indexing
policy.locations: TileLocation is placement intent and does not restrict pto-v0 TEPL raw-carrier semantics
policy.source_aliases: source/destination aliases are legal when a single destination exists; sources are snapshotted before destination writes
policy.multi_destination_aliases: same-output aliases are rejected for TSORT32 because two architectural destinations would otherwise conflict
policy.partial_regions: TINSERT and TSCATTER require the destination valid region to be defined before partial update; generated/replacement operations define the destination valid region atomically
policy.indices: TGATHER index tiles select source elements; TSCATTER duplicate indices commit in source linear order and the last write wins
policy.sort_merge: TSORT32 uses deterministic stable bubble-sort ordering; TMRGSORT is stable left-biased on equal keys
policy.histogram: THISTOGRAM is not accepted in PTO ISA 0.58.0
policy.tprelu: TPRELU is reserved in PTO ISA 0.58.0; TFMA uses the profile-owned fused multiply-add boundary

known_open_items: S5-T2 numeric conformance for profile-owned arithmetic, conversion, rounding, saturation, and exceptional-value behavior
